title: Research capability contract freeze (BADF-WP-RSR-001): one stable meaning before any research subskill exists
objective: Freeze the semantics of BADF Research -- types, depths, lifecycle, evidence contracts, routing and authority boundaries, acceptance controls -- as documents, one schema and a root skill at DESIGNED, so every later subskill, validator and council integration shares one foundation. Nothing runnable; nothing ACTIVE.
business_value: Once nine research skills exist, changing the meaning of VERIFIED, RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT, source provenance, confidence, challenge independence or the research->authority boundary is expensive and dangerous. Freeze first.
in_scope: skills/badf-research/SKILL.md (root, DESIGNED) + references: research-types, lifecycle, evidence-contract, routing-and-authority, acceptance
schemas/research-record.schema.json with implementation_authority machine-fixed to false
examples/research-record.json (a shadow record of a real 2026-08-28 finding) + templates/research-record.json
registry entry badf-research DESIGNED with a real digest
doctrine: Research records paragraph in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md
drift tests: documented taxonomy == schema enums; invariants RSR-I01..I05 stated; no competing research validator under scripts/
out_of_scope: any research runtime, router, council mechanism or validator script
acceptance_criteria: research-types R01-R10, depths D0-D5, states, dispositions, claim classifications, claim statuses, source types and confidence levels documented and equal to the schema enums (drift test)
the example record passes check_schema and the drift walker; implementation_authority: true is refused by the schema
registry entry status DESIGNED, digest == sha256(SKILL.md)
RSR-I01..I05 present verbatim in the references

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Resulting capability state: DESIGN approved, CONTRACT frozen, IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED/SHADOWED/APPROVED/ACTIVE all NO.
